profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | .NET, C#, Azure, AWS | Backend, Cloud, APIs
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience designing and building backend systems, APIs, cloud-native solutions, and data-driven applications using C# and .NET. I have worked across Azure, AWS, and GCP, building scalable and maintainable software in cloud and containerized environments.

I have contributed to more than 20 technology projects, delivering solutions that support business goals and create measurable value. My background includes software architecture, backend engineering, object-oriented design, data platforms, AI-enabled solutions, SQL Server, and enterprise application development. I also bring additional experience in mobile development with React Native, Ionic, Xamarin Forms, and .NET MAUI.

I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building reliable systems that are efficient, practical, and built to last.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and develop scalable backend systems, APIs, and cloud-based applications to support business-critical products and services.
• Analyze technical and business requirements and translate them into reliable, maintainable, and secure software solutions.
• Contribute to system design, software architecture, and service integration across distributed and containerized environments.
• Build and enhance data-driven applications, working with databases, system integrations, and cloud services to improve performance and reliability.
• Support software quality through testing, troubleshooting, maintenance, and continuous improvement of existing systems.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver technical solutions aligned with business goals, engineering standards, and operational needs.
• Document system components, technical decisions, and implementation details to support long-term maintenance and future enhancements.
• Contribute to engineering best practices in areas such as code quality, security, deployment workflows, and production support.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .NET Framework · Microsoft Azure · Software Architecture · REST APIs

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented scalable APIs using Node.js and Azure to support system integration and enhance application capabilities.
• Built three backend applications with Node.js for efficient and scalable API processing.
• Improved database performance by optimizing SQL tables and queries, increasing API responsiveness and overall system efficiency by 80%.
• Leveraged Azure DevOps for version control, collaboration, and CI/CD, contributing to a 90% faster development workflow.
• Acted as a security advocate within the team, helping maintain compliance with security policies and development best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Code Review · Continuous Delivery (CD) · Analytical Skills · JavaScript · Debugging · SQL · Bootstrapping · Full-Stack Development · Problem Solving · HTML5 · 3rd Party Integrations · JSON · Node.js · Unit Testing · Computer Science · GitHub · Engineering · API Testing · Programming · Windows Server · Azure Functions · C# · Microsoft Azure · C# in .NET · Agile Environment · Agile Software Development

positions.title: Associate Principal Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and deployed cloud-based applications using AWS, Terraform, ASP.NET Core, C#, and .NET.
• Designed and implemented a high-performance serverless API with AWS API Gateway and Terraform.
• Maintained and improved RESTful API services built with ASP.NET Core, helping ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability.
• Collaborated closely with QA, business stakeholders, and developers to align requirements, testing, and delivery.
• Contributed to application quality by resolving defects across project modules and supporting a stable production-ready solution.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Led the successful development and delivery of over 20 high-end technology projects for a diverse
clientele.
• Achieved a consistent track record of delivering innovative solutions tailored to meet the unique
requirements of each project.
• Implemented cutting-edge solutions using a diverse technology stack, including C#, ASP.NET MVC,
React, Angular, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework.
• Customized solutions for diverse clientele, meeting unique project requirements and achieving a 20%
increase in client retention and positive feedback.
• Utilized Azure DevOps for streamlined project management, resulting in a 90% reduction in
development cycle time and improved collaboration across the team.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the implementation of new features and integrations for client applications, utilizing a
tech stack encompassing C#, ASP.NET, SQL, Angular, Ionic, and other cutting-edge technologies.
• Orchestrated seamless integration of new features into client applications, leveraging technologies like
Angular, React, and Bootstrap.
• Worked in the implementation of cutting-edge solutions with Ionic and Xamarin, enhancing
cross-platform compatibility and contributing to a 20% increase in the reach of client applications.
• Played a key role in the migration to .NET Framework 4.5 and MVC 5.0, ensuring compatibility with the
latest industry standards and achieving a 30% improvement in overall system performance.

positions.title: WEB, SEO & ONLINE MARKETING SERVICES
positions.description:
• Designed and built responsive websites using PHP, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
• Provided SEO and web marketing services to enhance website visibility and user reach.
• Developed user-friendly interfaces and front-end components with a focus on usability and responsive design.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Debugging · Problem Solving · HTML5 · Computer Science · Engineering · WordPress · PHP
